steps: With the commission complete, Mina invites the group over and brings up a past information leak. The report Mina submitted are met with total silence. You decide to go for another sweep of the greenhouse.
Those people didn't back down, as expected. They're even closing in on the truth.
It doesn't matter. With Mina there, even if they find the truth, I'll keep them stalled.
Let me see... Too many departments and individuals are tangled up in this.
Until at least the 5th of next month, I think.
That long? What on earth are those people up to... Fine, I'll do my best to stall them until then.
6:30, Calor Month 14th, Greenhouse District in Philae, United Harvest Warehouse
Yawn... Man, I'm toast. Mina, Iris, how'd those numbers turn out? Found anything?
F-finally done...==W== I ran the check again. The data doesn't lie. This is the result.
Here's the verdict:==W== nine out of ninety-nine greenhouses have been using 200% more wheat seed than average over the last two months.
That's way beyond normal waste. Someone has to be using magic to force-grow the wheat in there.
You guys move fast. Pretty thorough job. So, let's go stake out those sheds and nab the guy, yeah?
We can't. Our mandate is investigation only—no arrests.
I'll submit the evidence to HQ. Let the company deal with it.
Let the company deal with it, huh... Nine greenhouses, totally unnoticed for two months. Who could pull that off?
Iris, Mistique, ==PLAYER_NAME== ... and everyone else not here, good work.
That wraps up the Golden Nightingale investigation. Since we finally have a day off, why not come over to my place for dinner? Let's celebrate.
10:00, Calor Month 14th, Silver District in Philae, Mina's Home
Make yourselves at home. Sorry...==W== It's a bit of a tight squeeze in here.
Nia, Aila. You two been behaving yourselves?
I was super good! I made dinner last night and breakfast this morning.
And I cleaned up the house.
Mina... Could you not work so late next time? It gets kinda scary when it's just us here.
I'm sorry... I promise I won't stay out that late again.
Liar. You say that every time, but you didn't even come home last night!
Ah-haha... I promise, for real this time! No matter how late it gets, I'll come home.
Everyone, meet my little sisters—Aila and Nia.
Come on, say hello to our guests.
11:00, Calor Month 14th, Silver District in Philae, Mina's Home
Then what?! That giant Bark Boar was charging right at you! What did you do?
It's not just a "giant Bark Boar." It has a proper name! It's the Spirit of... Uh...==W== Right, the Spirit of Brutality.
Well, the Spirit of Brutality realized ==PLAYER_NAME== was calling the shots and went berserk. It ripped a massive boulder out of the ground and hurled it straight at us!
Don't worry. Fuyuka stepped in with a solid right hook—BAM! That rock shattered into dust. Then she followed up with a left hook that sent the Spirit of Brutality flying into the sky!
N-Noya, please... You're making it sound way more dramatic than it actually was...
Fuyuka! Can you show us? Please? Show us the hooks!
Yeah, do it! Look, this pillow can be the Spirit of Brutality, and...==W== I'll use this apple for its nose!
Hey now, don't waste food.==W== Why don't you play with me instead? I've got something really fun planned.
Oh yeah? Is it cooler than fighting a giant monster?
Absolutely. I've curated a selection of math problems perfectly tailored for your age group.==W== I tested them myself—they're incredibly practical. You'll love them.
What a nostalgic sight. There's nothing quite like seeing everyone together, getting along so warmly.
Yeah. Everyone's been on edge lately. What a relief to finally see them relax.
Thank you all. I'm away so much these days... It's been a long time since I've heard Nia and Aila laugh like that.
Don't mention it. Noya and the others said playing with the kids brings back happy memories of the orphanage. They're having a blast, too.
Speaking of which, I haven't seen your parents. Are they out? Should we make extra for lunch?
No need. They aren't in Philae right now. They're working far, far to the south—==W==at the United Harvest Lushwood Jungle Branch.
The Lushwood Jungle Branch? Isn't that on the southern edge of the Empire...?==W== But with kids at home, why do they have to work so far away?
Well...==W== Four years ago, there was a major incident at the Philae Branch.
The former R&D Director—Director Joseph's predecessor—was arrested for leaking secrets to witches and embezzling funds.
My parents were in R&D back then, and they were found partially responsible for what happened.

Luckily, the compliance inspector in charge was a stickler for protocol. She ruled that my parents were merely implicated. So instead of being exiled like the former Director, they were just transferred to the Lushwood Jungle Branch.
So that's the skeleton in United Harvest's closet...
After they left, their pay was cut drastically. I was still in school... We fell on hard times almost overnight.
But that anonymous compliance inspector saved us, cited a regulation about employee welfare, and got the company to grant us a subsidy.
Later, when Tawny Nightingale launched, we started getting weekly shipments. It was enough to keep us fed.
To me, Tawny Nightingale tastes better than anything else in the world.
I see... The rules are what got you through. No wonder you were really against us breaking protocol or looking for loopholes during the investigation.
It might sound dramatic...==W== But without those rules, I wouldn't be here today.
If everyone ignored the rules like that Director or those witches, imagine the chaos. Imagine how many people would suffer.
I don't know the details, but it's not like the witches are totally lawless. They have their own code, don't they?
Maybe. But to me, they're just selfish people who only care about themselves. I hate witches.
... Yeah. Guess they aren't exactly winning any popularity contests.
Oh ★ Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
15:00, Calor Month 14th, Silver District in Philae, Mina's Home
Noya, will you come back and tell us more stories next time?
I wanna hear about your adventure on the Waterway!
You got it! Besides, Mina's an amazing cook—I'm hoping to learn a few local dishes from her while I'm here.
Mina, how long till we hear back on that report?
Since the "big shots" are all over this, maybe as soon as tomorrow. A week, tops.
Until then, mind sticking around United Harvest a little longer?
Sure. Marketing's actually been pretty interesting.
I've learned a ton in R&D. Once this job's done, maybe I can finally be of some real help to everyone.
Something wrong, Mistique? Mina's words sting?==W== She doesn't know you're a witch—it wasn't personal.
Sharp eyes. That's the great Boss for you.
Being hated is part of the gig for a witch. I'm not gonna get depressed over a couple of stray comments.
But..==W== seeing Mina and her sisters sticking together like that... even though I don‘t know who that witch from the past really was, it still makes me feel a little guilty.
Boss, what takes priority: following the rules, or uncovering the truth?
Rules are meant to be broken!
Surely there's a way to follow the rules and still get to the truth?
In theory. But just like a claw machine—does feeding it coins guarantee you a prize?
Exactly. So when the claw fails, you face a choice: keep feeding it coins, or break the machine open.
Would anyone actually break it open?
Maybe not after twenty losses. But two hundred?==W== Your mindset might change.
Fair point... I'd at least suspect the claw was rigged.
Rules create stability. And stability protects the majority.
So, if we break the rules to find the truth, does that make us villains?
I never said that. But if a rule crumbles just because a witch poked it,==W== it was likely weak to begin with, no?
You have a weird way of comforting people.
I'm not offering comfort. A stable system should be self-repairing. It's a natural cycle of breaking and mending.
Oh? So whatever is left standing in the end is "Justice"?==W== The ultimate rule?
Precisely. Survival of the fittest. Rules evolve or die out, just like everything else in nature.
Rules are made to be broken!==W== As the Boss, that's what I'd really like to say.
But then I realized: if I break the rules, as the Boss, I have to write the new ones. Total pain in the neck.
Besides, breaking rules doesn't guarantee finding the truth. Nor does it promise a better system.
Like, if I were CEO of Scarlet Sights Media, I'd have you write three articles a day, three thousand words each, no holidays.
Whoa, hey! Tyrant, you really are evil!
Anyway, that's my take. Forget the philosophy of rules. Let's focus on the commission.
You're right, Boss. A witch shouldn't get tripped up by the small stuff. I'm after the truth. Time to get back to work.
So, Boss, what do you think will come of Mina's report?
The Golden Nightingale issue spans nine greenhouses. That's not a job for small fry.
Out of everyone we've met, only two have the muscle to pull that off...
Director Joseph from R&D, our helpful friend.
And Firenze, the one running Production.==W== They're the only ones with the rank to cover up a mess this big.
15:30, Calor Month 21st, Greenhouse District in Philae, United Harvest R&D Department
Noya, the cake looks perfect. Experiment successful.
Yeah! Using wind magic to boost the baking temp actually works. Make a note for the report.
It's been a week. Still no word on that report Mina sent up?
Mm. Mina mentioned this morning that the directors are in a meeting.==W== We should hear something soon.
10:00, Calor Month 28th, Greenhouse District in Philae, United Harvest Production Department
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing! ♪==W== Stretch your body, up and away! ♪
Phew, another easy day.==W== Hey, Sapphire, Production looks pretty empty. Can we actually handle ninety-nine greenhouses on our own?
It's manageable. The Mandrake Radiant Grass guards most of the houses. We just need to make rounds once a week to keep them in line.
Two weeks now, and Mina's report has sunk without a trace.==W== It's clearly a dead end, yet she's still telling us to wait.
She must have a plan.==W== Besides, sitting tight isn't all bad. Remember the anonymous source who tipped you off when we first joined?
Hard to forget. I still haven't managed to track them down.
Since we're stalled here, they're probably getting restless, too. I bet they'll make a move soon.
17:00, Messis Month 4th, Silver District in Philae, United Harvest Store
You are just the cutest! I'll definitely be back.
Iris? What are you doing here?
Nyx is off today.==W== I finished my spreadsheets early, so I'm covering the promo shift for her.
Off ... again?==W== Why does Nyx take every Friday off? She's always late on Thursdays, too.
Nothing concrete...==W== But we've heard that Radiant Grass usually only needs weekly tuning. ==SEX1== found that suspicious.
Wait. If someone sneaks in after the official maintenance, tweaks the settings, then resets them right before the next check...==W== They could do whatever they want, unnoticed!
We need to tell the others. Now.
21:00, Messis Month 4th, Greenhouse District in Philae, Greenhouse No.99
==PLAYER_NAME==, stop!==W== We can't just barge into a Production Department greenhouse without authorization...

Mina, listen. I've been digging.==W== Those nine suspicious greenhouses? Production services them on Fridays during the day.==W== If anyone wanted to use magic to speed up growth, Friday night is the perfect window.
I heard you... They tamper with the Grass, then reset them to cover their tracks. I get it.==W== But evidence obtained illegally is useless!
United Harvest mercenaries? Why are they guarding a greenhouse?
See, Mina? We aren't the only ones bending rules. Pretty sure "armed mercenaries" aren't part of standard gardening protocol.
N-No, it wasn't me. I didn't shoot.
Guess there's no way out but through.==W== Pumpka & Lanterna, it's showtime ★
